market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: Russell is 2nd with 63 pts, 9 behind teammate Antonelli (72) after early-season races; Leclerc 3rd at 49. Mercedes is competitive but Russell trails his rookie teammate, so chance is meaningful but not the leading favorite.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Reliability/luck and whether Mercedes development pace persists vs Ferrari/RB.
